title: A codimension-5 Hopf bifurcation yielding 5 limit cycles in a SIRS epidemic model with nonlinear incidence rate
summary: In a recent paper published in the Journal of Differential Equations (384, 2024), Cui and Zhao investigated an SIRS epidemic model with the nonlinear incidence rate $\frac{kI^p}{1+αI^q}$, where $p>0$ and $q\geq0$ are arbitrary real numbers. They proved that the codimension of a Bogdanov-Takens bifurcation in this model is at most two, while the codimension of the Hopf bifurcation was left as an open problem. In this work, we investigate this problem while keeping $p$ and $q$ free throughout the analysis. A strategic nondimensionalization and parametrization remove the exponential dependence…
